rules.title: Game rules
rules.intro: Everything that decides your team and your points in Fudaristo — squad, lineup, transfers, chips, and the exact scoring system for every Super League Greece gameweek.

squad.title: Squad
squad.sub: A {size}-player squad, a {budget}M budget, and a per-club limit — the same for every manager at the start.
squad.rule1: Your squad must have exactly {gk} goalkeepers, {def} defenders, {mid} midfielders and {fwd} forwards.
squad.rule2: The combined price of all {size} players can't exceed your available budget.
squad.rule3: At most {max} players from the same real club can be in your squad at once.
squad.rule4: Before your first deadline (building your first squad), transfers are unlimited and free — normal transfer rules apply from then on.

lineup.title: Lineup (starting XI)
lineup.sub: Out of {size} players, each gameweek you pick {starting} to start and {bench} for the bench. The formation must stay within these bounds:
lineup.rule1: Exactly {bench} players stay on the bench, including one reserve goalkeeper.
lineup.rule2: Bench order (who comes on first if a starter plays no minutes) is set when you save your lineup.
lineup.rule3: The formation can be changed up to each gameweek's deadline — after that, the lineup locks for that gameweek.

captain.title: Captain and vice-captain
captain.sub: You pick a captain and vice-captain from your lineup before every deadline.
captain.rule1: The captain scores double (×2) points for that gameweek.
captain.rule2: If the captain plays 0 minutes, the multiplier automatically passes to the vice-captain (if they played).
captain.rule3: If neither the captain nor the vice-captain played a single minute, no one carries the multiplier that gameweek.
captain.rule4: With the Triple Captain chip active, the captain scores ×3 instead of ×2 — see Chips.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.sub: Any free transfer you don't use carries over to the next gameweek.
transfers.rule1: You get 1 new free transfer every gameweek; unused ones stack up to {max}.
transfers.rule2: Every transfer beyond your free ones costs {cost} points that gameweek.
transfers.rule3: Before your first deadline in the league, transfers are unlimited and free.

autosubs.title: Auto-substitutions
autosubs.sub: If someone in your lineup doesn't play at all, the bench automatically replaces them when points are calculated — you don't have to change anything by hand.
autosubs.rule1: A starter who plays 0 minutes is replaced by a bench player, following bench order.
autosubs.rule2: The goalkeeper can only be replaced by the reserve goalkeeper on your bench.
autosubs.rule3: An outfield substitution only applies if the lineup still respects the formation bounds afterward.
autosubs.rule4: If no bench substitution is valid, your team plays that gameweek with fewer than 11 players contributing points.

chips.title: Chips
chips.sub: Each chip can be used only once per season, and at most one chip can be active in a given gameweek.
chips.footer: You activate a chip before the deadline of the gameweek you want it to apply to — it can't be cancelled after the deadline.

scoring.title: Scoring

about.title: About us
about.lead: Fudaristo is an unofficial fantasy game for the Greek Super League — for everyone who likes to pick their own squad and follow every gameweek.

sections.title: What is Fudaristo
sections.body:
You build a squad of 15 players from Super League clubs on a 100M budget, choose your lineup and a captain, and your players earn points from what they actually do on the pitch: goals, assists, ratings and other match events.

After each gameweek you can change your squad with transfers.

sections.title: The competition
sections.body: Points add up in the overall league, and after each gameweek you can see the Team of the Week and player stats.

sections.title: Unofficial game
sections.body: Fudaristo is not affiliated with the Greek Super League, its clubs or its players. Club and player names are used for information only, and all names and marks belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: Feedback
sections.body: It is welcome — get in touch through the Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Short and clear: what data we keep, why, and what you can do with it.

sections.title: What data we keep
sections.body: Your email address and password (the password is stored only in a protected, hashed form), your team name and colour, your favourite club, and your squad, transfers and points in the game.

sections.title: Why
sections.body:
Only to make the game work: sign-in, showing your team, the league and the standings. We do not sell data and we do not send advertising.

Your team name, colour and points are visible to other signed-in players.

sections.title: Storage and security
sections.body:
Data is stored on protected servers and access to it is restricted.

To run the site (hosting, data storage, bot protection) we use trusted technical partners, who process data only for that purpose.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We only use necessary cookies: for sign-in (session) and for your chosen language. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your account and data — write to us through the Contact page.
